notes.title: URG 1.83
notes.content:
URG has been updated to version 1.83.

- Fixed a bug where the game would in some cases freeze in the ship selection screen
- Added a secondary weapon! Try the B-button or the right shoulder button on the game controller. Both weapons can be used at the same time (the primary weapon is on A-button and the left shoulder button)
- Moved the camera further back and scaled down the ships slightly. This gives much more spacious feeling and the camera is no longer "on your face".
- Added chromatic aberration post-render effect and slight screen distortion for some more "retro" feeling
- Made the tutorial more interesting by adding a bunch of enemies in the early levels!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36450818/c44422e1c8b155ee8491200c3810359f207b50f1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Build 1.75 fixes and improvements
notes.content:
- The latest version includes many small improvements, such as many new sound effects and more information about the weapons.
- The most important bug fix is that the ship configuration screen used to show up twice before some levels - this has now been fixed.
- There are now sound and visual effects when the ship hits a wall
- You now get coin rewards for breaking down those small asteroids. I noticed from gameplay videos posted on YouTube that many of you like to blast those, so I figured it should be rewarded!
- Some people seem to be stuck on the very first level, so I added an arrow pointing at the lever you need to either shoot or hit with your ship to open the door.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36450818/c4066958f2c64b324522d8661a57f7cb54c9ddd2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: URG Version 1.72
notes.content:
- The game now defaults to opening in full screen
- Adjusted coin rewards higher and some purchase prices lower to make it easier to reach new weapons and ships.
